schema.name: access_grant
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE access_grant (
  id            TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id        TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id),
  subject_type  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (subject_type IN ('group', 'email')),
  subject_value TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (subject_type = 'group' OR subject_value = lower(subject_value)),
  subject_provider TEXT CHECK ((subject_type = 'group' AND subject_provider IS NOT NULL AND length(subject_provider) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND subject_provider = trim(subject_provider)) OR (subject_type = 'email' AND subject_provider IS NULL)),
  scope         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('organization', 'project')),
  project_id    TEXT REFERENCES project (id),
  role_id       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES role (id),
  created_by    TEXT,
  created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')), revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision >= 1), last_op_id TEXT,
  CHECK ((scope = 'organization' AND project_id IS NULL) OR (scope = 'project' AND project_id IS NOT NULL))
) STRICT

schema.name: access_mutation_guard
api_idempotency
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE api_idempotency (
  org_id        TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id),
  principal_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(principal_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 80),
  key           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(key) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
  route         TEXT NOT NULL,
  request_hash  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(request_hash) = 64),
  status        INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (status BETWEEN 100 AND 599),
  response_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(response_json)),
  created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (org_id, principal_key, key)
) STRICT

schema.name: audit_event
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE audit_event (
  id             TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id         TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id),
  seq            INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (seq >= 1),
  prev_hash      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(prev_hash) = 64),
  hash           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(hash) = 64),
  created_at     TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_type     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (actor_type IN ('user', 'service_principal', 'customer', 'system')),
  actor_id       TEXT,
  token_selector TEXT,
  source_ip      TEXT,
  action         TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_type    TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_id      TEXT,
  project_id     TEXT,
  payload_json   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(payload_json))
) STRICT

schema.name: audit_pending
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE audit_pending (
  id             TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id         TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id),
  created_at     TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_type     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (actor_type IN ('user', 'service_principal', 'customer', 'system')),
  actor_id       TEXT,
  token_selector TEXT,
  source_ip      TEXT,
  action         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(action) BETWEEN 3 AND 64),
  target_type    TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_id      TEXT,
  project_id     TEXT,
  payload_json   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(payload_json) AND length(CAST(payload_json AS BLOB)) <= 4096)
) STRICT

schema.name: blob
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE blob (
  id               TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id           TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id),
  sha256           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(sha256) = 64 AND sha256 = lower(sha256)),
  size_bytes       INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (size_bytes >= 0),
  storage_key      TEXT NOT NULL,
  media_type       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'application/octet-stream',
  refetchable      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (refetchable IN (0, 1)),
  upstream_url     TEXT,
  last_fetched_at  TEXT,
  last_accessed_at TEXT,
  purge_after      TEXT,
  deleted_at       TEXT,
  created_at       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))
, purge_generation TEXT, purge_lease_until TEXT, published_at TEXT) STRICT

  updated_at        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),

schema.name: identity
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE identity (
  id             TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id         TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id),
  user_id        TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES user_account (id),
  provider       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(provider) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND provider = trim(provider)),
  subject        TEXT NOT NULL,
  email          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (email = lower(email)),
  email_verified INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (email_verified IN (0, 1)),
  created_at     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),

schema.name: identity_block

schema.name: identity_provider_binding

CREATE TABLE identity_provider_binding (

schema.name: import_ref
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE import_ref (

  created_at        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))
, published_at_basis TEXT CHECK (published_at_basis IS NULL OR published_at_basis IN ('source_release', 'packagist_added', 'import_time')), expired_at TEXT) STRICT

schema.name: import_run
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE import_run (
  id                      TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id                  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id),
  source_system           TEXT NOT NULL,
  state                   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned' CHECK (state IN ('planned', 'applying', 'failed', 'applied', 'verifying', 'verified', 'rolled_back', 'cancelled')),
  plan_hash               TEXT,
  planned_count           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (planned_count >= 0),
  applied_count           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (applied_count >= 0),

, approved_by_user_id TEXT REFERENCES user_account (id), approved_at TEXT, credential_window_until TEXT, started_by_service_principal_id TEXT REFERENCES service_principal (id), manifest_blob_sha256 TEXT CHECK (manifest_blob_sha256 IS NULL OR length(manifest_blob_sha256) = 64), rollback_restored_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (rollback_restored_count >= 0), rollback_conflict_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (rollback_conflict_count >= 0), rollback_expired_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (rollback_expired_count >= 0)) STRICT

schema.name: ingest_session
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE ingest_session (
  id                   TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id               TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id),
  scope                TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('source', 'package')),
  scope_key            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(scope_key) = 64 AND scope_key = lower(scope_key) AND scope_key NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  source_id            TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  package_key          TEXT,
  generation           INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generation >= 1),
  owner                TEXT NOT NULL,
  fence                INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (fence >= 1),
  lease_until          TEXT NOT NULL,
  state                TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('running', 'complete', 'abandoned')),
  snapshot_id          TEXT,
  snapshot_blob_sha256 TEXT CHECK (snapshot_blob_sha256 IS NULL OR (length(snapshot_blob_sha256) = 64 AND snapshot_blob_sha256 = lower(snapshot_blob_sha256) AND snapshot_blob_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
  stamp                TEXT,
  cursor               TEXT CHECK (cursor IS NULL OR length(cursor) <= 4096),
  seen_count           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (seen_count >= 0),
  pending_validators   TEXT CHECK (pending_validators IS NULL OR CASE WHEN json_valid(pending_validators) THEN json_type(pending_validators) = 'object' ELSE 0 END),
  pages_so_far         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (pages_so_far >= 0),
  started_at           TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at           TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK ((scope = 'package') = (package_key IS NOT NULL))
) STRICT

schema.name: job
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE job (
  id                 TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id             TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id),
  type               TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload_json       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(payload_json) AND length(payload_json) <= 131072),
  resource_key       TEXT,
  idempotency_key    TEXT,
  state              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued' CHECK (state IN ('queued', 'running', 'succeeded', 'dead')),
  attempts           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0),
  max_attempts       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5 CHECK (max_attempts >= 1),
  lease_owner        TEXT,
  lease_until        TEXT,
  fence              INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (fence >= 0),
  run_at             TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  last_error         TEXT,
  sync_error         TEXT,
  finished_at        TEXT,
  created_at         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  project_id         TEXT REFERENCES project (id),
  initiator_token_id TEXT,
  CHECK (state <> 'running' OR (lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL))
) STRICT

schema.name: job_attempt

schema.name: job_schedule

CREATE TABLE job_schedule (

schema.name: keyring_verifier

schema.name: migration_lock

schema.name: organization

schema.name: package

schema.name: project_package

schema.name: representation_clock

schema.name: role

schema.name: service_principal_permission

schema.name: session

CREATE TABLE session (

schema.name: source
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE source (
  id                              TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id                          TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id),
  project_id                      TEXT REFERENCES project (id),
  name                            TEXT NOT NULL,
  ecosystem                       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (ecosystem IN ('composer', 'npm')),
  type                            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('vcs', 'composer_repository', 'npm_registry', 'packagist_proxy', 'npmjs_proxy', 'hosted')),
  url                             TEXT,
  credential_id                   TEXT REFERENCES credential (id),
  config_json                     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(config_json)),
  protocol_mode                   TEXT CHECK (protocol_mode IS NULL OR protocol_mode IN ('v2', 'v1-providers', 'v1-lazy', 'v1-includes', 'npm-packument')),
  has_available_packages          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (has_available_packages IN (0, 1)),
  user_agent                      TEXT,
  default_visible_to_new_projects INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (default_visible_to_new_projects IN (0, 1)),
  removal_policy                  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'flag' CHECK (removal_policy IN ('flag', 'exclude')),
  retention_days_override         INTEGER CHECK (retention_days_override IS NULL OR retention_days_override >= 0),
  status                          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'degraded', 'failing', 'paused')),
  poll_interval_seconds           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 86400 CHECK (poll_interval_seconds > 0),
  next_poll_at                    TEXT,
  last_polled_at                  TEXT,
  last_success_at                 TEXT,
  poll_etag                       TEXT,
  poll_last_modified              TEXT,
  root_hash                       TEXT,
  listing_hash                    TEXT,
  consecutive_failures            INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (consecutive_failures >= 0),
  last_error                      TEXT,
  created_at                      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  updated_at                      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  listing_open_stamp              TEXT,
  listing_opened_at               TEXT,
  last_refusal_at                 TEXT,
  last_refusal_absent             INTEGER CHECK (last_refusal_absent IS NULL OR last_refusal_absent >= 0),
  last_refusal_listed             INTEGER CHECK (last_refusal_listed IS NULL OR last_refusal_listed >= 0),
  last_refusal_successful         INTEGER CHECK (last_refusal_successful IS NULL OR last_refusal_successful >= 0),
  removal_accepted                INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (removal_accepted IN (0, 1)),
  sync_generation                 TEXT,
  sync_counts                     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"listing":true,"queued":0,"running":0,"retrying":0,"failed":0,"completed":0,"errors":{}}' CHECK (json_valid(sync_counts)),
  CHECK ((last_refusal_at IS NULL) = (last_refusal_absent IS NULL)
    AND (last_refusal_at IS NULL) = (last_refusal_listed IS NULL)
    AND (last_refusal_at IS NULL) = (last_refusal_successful IS NULL)),
  CHECK (removal_accepted = 0 OR last_refusal_at IS NOT NULL)
) STRICT

schema.name: source_sync_package
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE source_sync_package (
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id),
  source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  package_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  generation TEXT NOT NULL,

  error TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (org_id, source_id, package_key)
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: token
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE token (
  id                   TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id               TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id),
  kind                 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('pat', 'svc', 'cst')),
  selector             TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(selector) = 12),
  hash                 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(hash) = 64),
  pepper_version       INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (pepper_version >= 1),
  name                 TEXT NOT NULL,
  scopes_json          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(scopes_json)),
  read_only            INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (read_only IN (0, 1)),
  user_id              TEXT REFERENCES user_account (id),
  service_principal_id TEXT REFERENCES service_principal (id),
  customer_id          TEXT REFERENCES customer (id),
  project_id           TEXT REFERENCES project (id),
  created_by_user_id   TEXT REFERENCES user_account (id),
  expires_at           TEXT,
  revoked_at           TEXT,
  last_used_at         TEXT,
  created_at           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')), project_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'selected' CHECK (project_mode IN ('all', 'selected')), validation_kind TEXT CHECK (validation_kind IS NULL OR (validation_kind IN ('sso', 'local') AND kind = 'pat')), validation_identity_id TEXT REFERENCES identity (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  CHECK (validation_identity_id IS NULL OR (validation_kind IS NOT 'local' AND kind = 'pat')), last_op_id TEXT,
  CHECK (
    (kind = 'pat' AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND service_principal_id IS NULL AND customer_id IS NULL) OR
    (kind = 'svc' AND service_principal_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NULL AND customer_id IS NULL) OR
    (kind = 'cst' AND customer_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NULL AND service_principal_id IS NULL)
  ),
  CHECK (kind = 'cst' OR expires_at IS NOT NULL),
  FOREIGN KEY (org_id, validation_identity_id, user_id) REFERENCES identity (org_id, id, user_id)
) STRICT

schema.name: token_project
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE token_project (
  org_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id),
  token_id   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES token (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES project (id),
  PRIMARY KEY (token_id, project_id)
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: upstream_state
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE upstream_state (
  org_id             TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization (id),
  package_id         TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES package (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  form               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (form IN ('composer-p2', 'composer-p2-dev', 'composer-v1-provider', 'npm-packument')),
  etag               TEXT,
  last_modified      TEXT,
  content_sha256     TEXT CHECK (content_sha256 IS NULL OR (length(content_sha256) = 64 AND content_sha256 = lower(content_sha256) AND content_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
  checked_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
  fresh_until        TEXT NOT NULL,
  not_found_count    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (not_found_count >= 0),
  first_not_found_at TEXT,

schema.name: version
schema.sql:

  deprecated_message   TEXT,

  removed_upstream_at  TEXT,
  tombstoned_at        TEXT,
  tombstone_reason     TEXT,
  purge_after          TEXT,
  revision             INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision >= 1),

schema.name: vulnerability_advisory
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE vulnerability_advisory (
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'osv' CHECK (source = 'osv'),
  advisory_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(CAST(advisory_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND instr(advisory_id, '/') = 0 AND instr(advisory_id, char(92)) = 0 AND advisory_id NOT IN ('.', '..')),
  detail_json TEXT CHECK (detail_json IS NULL OR (length(CAST(detail_json AS BLOB)) <= 65536 AND json_valid(detail_json) AND json_type(detail_json) = 'object')),
  summary TEXT CHECK (summary IS NULL OR length(CAST(summary AS BLOB)) <= 8192),
  severity_json TEXT CHECK (severity_json IS NULL OR (length(CAST(severity_json AS BLOB)) <= 16384 AND json_valid(severity_json))),
  modified_at TEXT CHECK (modified_at IS NULL OR (length(modified_at) = 24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', modified_at) IS modified_at)),
  fetched_at TEXT CHECK (fetched_at IS NULL OR (length(fetched_at) = 24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', fetched_at) IS fetched_at)),
  next_attempt_at TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(next_attempt_at) = 24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', next_attempt_at) IS next_attempt_at),
  failure_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (failure_count BETWEEN 0 AND 1000),
  last_error_code TEXT CHECK (last_error_code IN ('unavailable', 'protocol', 'config', 'limit')),
  PRIMARY KEY (org_id, source, advisory_id)
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: vulnerability_match
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE vulnerability_match (
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  version_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'osv' CHECK (source = 'osv'),
  advisory_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(CAST(advisory_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND instr(advisory_id, '/') = 0 AND instr(advisory_id, char(92)) = 0 AND advisory_id NOT IN ('.', '..')),
  advisory_modified_at TEXT CHECK (advisory_modified_at IS NULL OR (length(advisory_modified_at) = 24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', advisory_modified_at) IS advisory_modified_at)),
  PRIMARY KEY (org_id, version_id, source, advisory_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (org_id, version_id, source) REFERENCES vulnerability_result(org_id, version_id, source) ON DELETE CASCADE
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: vulnerability_refresh
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE vulnerability_refresh (
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  refresh_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(refresh_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
  version_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'osv' CHECK (source = 'osv'),
  generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generation >= 0),
  mapping_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (mapping_version > 0),
  query_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  continuation_token TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(CAST(continuation_token AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 4096),
  page_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (page_count BETWEEN 1 AND 4),
  accumulated_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(CAST(accumulated_ids_json AS BLOB)) <= 65536 AND json_valid(accumulated_ids_json) AND json_type(accumulated_ids_json) = 'array' AND json_array_length(accumulated_ids_json) <= 200),
  started_at TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(started_at) = 24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', started_at) IS started_at),
  next_attempt_at TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(next_attempt_at) = 24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', next_attempt_at) IS next_attempt_at),
  PRIMARY KEY (org_id, refresh_id),
  UNIQUE (org_id, version_id, source),
  FOREIGN KEY (org_id, version_id, source) REFERENCES vulnerability_result(org_id, version_id, source) ON DELETE CASCADE
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: vulnerability_result
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE vulnerability_result (
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  version_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'osv' CHECK (source = 'osv'),
  package_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  ecosystem TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (ecosystem IN ('composer', 'npm')),
  package_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  version TEXT NOT NULL,
  query_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  mapping_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (mapping_version > 0),
  assessment TEXT CHECK (assessment IN ('affected', 'not_affected')),
  fetched_at TEXT CHECK (fetched_at IS NULL OR (length(fetched_at) = 24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', fetched_at) IS fetched_at)),
  attempted_at TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(attempted_at) = 24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', attempted_at) IS attempted_at),
  next_attempt_at TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(next_attempt_at) = 24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', next_attempt_at) IS next_attempt_at),
  failure_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (failure_count BETWEEN 0 AND 1000),
  last_error_code TEXT CHECK (last_error_code IN ('unavailable', 'protocol', 'config', 'limit')),
  generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generation >= 0),
  refresh_id TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (org_id, version_id, source),
  UNIQUE (org_id, ecosystem, package_id, version_id, source),
  FOREIGN KEY (org_id, version_id) REFERENCES version(org_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (org_id, package_id) REFERENCES package(org_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CHECK ((assessment IS NULL) = (fetched_at IS NULL))
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: vulnerability_sync_state
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE vulnerability_sync_state (
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organization(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'osv' CHECK (source = 'osv'),
  fence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (fence >= 0),
  lease_owner TEXT,
  lease_until TEXT CHECK (lease_until IS NULL OR (length(lease_until) = 24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', lease_until) IS lease_until)),
  next_request_at TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(next_request_at) = 24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', next_request_at) IS next_request_at),
  consecutive_failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (consecutive_failures BETWEEN 0 AND 1000),
  write_token TEXT,
  prune_cursor TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  selection_cursor TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"due":"","id":""}' CHECK (length(selection_cursor) <= 1024 AND json_valid(selection_cursor) AND json_type(selection_cursor) = 'object'),
  blocked_until TEXT CHECK (blocked_until IS NULL OR (length(blocked_until) = 24 AND strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', blocked_until) IS blocked_until)),
  CHECK ((lease_owner IS NULL) = (lease_until IS NULL)),
  PRIMARY KEY (org_id, source)
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: package_ecosystem_matches_source_insert

CREATE TRIGGER package_ecosystem_matches_source_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON package
WHEN (SELECT ecosystem FROM source WHERE id = NEW.source_id) IS NOT NEW.ecosystem
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'package ecosystem does not match source ecosystem');
END

schema.name: source_ecosystem_locked_with_packages

CREATE TRIGGER source_ecosystem_locked_with_packages
BEFORE UPDATE OF ecosystem ON source
WHEN NEW.ecosystem IS NOT OLD.ecosystem
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM package WHERE source_id = OLD.id)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'source ecosystem cannot change while the source holds packages');
END

schema.name: source_sync_counts_insert
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER source_sync_counts_insert
AFTER INSERT ON source_sync_package
BEGIN
  UPDATE source SET sync_counts = json_set((CASE WHEN NEW.error IS NULL THEN (sync_counts) ELSE json_set((sync_counts), '$.errors.' || NEW.error, COALESCE(json_extract((sync_counts), '$.errors.' || NEW.error), 0) + 1) END),
      '$.queued', json_extract(sync_counts, '$.queued') + (NEW.state = 'queued' AND NEW.error IS NULL),
      '$.running', json_extract(sync_counts, '$.running') + (NEW.state = 'running'),
      '$.retrying', json_extract(sync_counts, '$.retrying') + (NEW.state = 'queued' AND NEW.error IS NOT NULL),
      '$.failed', json_extract(sync_counts, '$.failed') + (NEW.state = 'dead'),
      '$.completed', json_extract(sync_counts, '$.completed') + (NEW.state = 'succeeded'))
    WHERE org_id = NEW.org_id AND id = NEW.source_id AND sync_generation = NEW.generation;
END

schema.name: source_sync_counts_update
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER source_sync_counts_update
AFTER UPDATE ON source_sync_package
BEGIN
  UPDATE source SET sync_counts = json_set(sync_counts, '$.errors.' || OLD.error,
      max(COALESCE(json_extract(sync_counts, '$.errors.' || OLD.error), 0) - 1, 0))
    WHERE org_id = NEW.org_id AND id = NEW.source_id AND sync_generation = NEW.generation
      AND OLD.error IS NOT NULL;
  UPDATE source SET sync_counts = json_set(sync_counts, '$.errors.' || NEW.error,
      COALESCE(json_extract(sync_counts, '$.errors.' || NEW.error), 0) + 1)
    WHERE org_id = NEW.org_id AND id = NEW.source_id AND sync_generation = NEW.generation
      AND NEW.error IS NOT NULL;
  UPDATE source SET sync_counts = json_set(sync_counts,
      '$.queued', json_extract(sync_counts, '$.queued') + ((NEW.state = 'queued' AND NEW.error IS NULL) - (OLD.state = 'queued' AND OLD.error IS NULL)),
      '$.running', json_extract(sync_counts, '$.running') + ((NEW.state = 'running') - (OLD.state = 'running')),
      '$.retrying', json_extract(sync_counts, '$.retrying') + ((NEW.state = 'queued' AND NEW.error IS NOT NULL) - (OLD.state = 'queued' AND OLD.error IS NOT NULL)),
      '$.failed', json_extract(sync_counts, '$.failed') + ((NEW.state = 'dead') - (OLD.state = 'dead')),
      '$.completed', json_extract(sync_counts, '$.completed') + ((NEW.state = 'succeeded') - (OLD.state = 'succeeded')))
    WHERE org_id = NEW.org_id AND id = NEW.source_id AND sync_generation = NEW.generation;
END

schema.name: source_sync_job_state
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER source_sync_job_state
AFTER UPDATE OF state, last_error ON job
BEGIN
  UPDATE source_sync_package SET state = NEW.state,
    error = CASE WHEN NEW.state IN ('running', 'succeeded') OR (NEW.state = 'queued' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job_attempt WHERE org_id = NEW.org_id AND job_id = NEW.id AND fence = NEW.fence AND outcome = 'released')) THEN NULL
      ELSE COALESCE(NEW.sync_error, CASE WHEN NEW.last_error = 'timeout' THEN 'timeout'
        WHEN NEW.last_error IS NOT NULL THEN 'internal' END) END
    WHERE org_id = NEW.org_id AND job_id = NEW.id;
  UPDATE source SET sync_counts = json_set(sync_counts, '$.listing', json('false'))
    WHERE org_id = NEW.org_id AND id = json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(NEW.payload_json) THEN NEW.payload_json ELSE '{}' END, '$.sourceId')
      AND NEW.type = 'core:source-sync:v1' AND NEW.state <> 'running'
      AND (NEW.state <> 'succeeded' OR NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM job continuation
        WHERE continuation.org_id = NEW.org_id AND continuation.resource_key = NEW.resource_key
          AND continuation.id <> NEW.id AND continuation.type = 'core:source-sync:v1'
          AND continuation.state IN ('queued', 'running')
          AND json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(continuation.payload_json) THEN continuation.payload_json ELSE '{}' END, '$.syncGeneration') = source.sync_generation))
      AND (json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(NEW.payload_json) THEN NEW.payload_json ELSE '{}' END, '$.syncGeneration') IS NULL
        OR sync_generation = json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(NEW.payload_json) THEN NEW.payload_json ELSE '{}' END, '$.syncGeneration'));
END

schema.name: source_sync_pause
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER source_sync_pause
AFTER UPDATE OF status ON source
WHEN NEW.status = 'paused'
BEGIN
  UPDATE source SET sync_counts = json_set(sync_counts, '$.listing', json('false'))
    WHERE org_id = NEW.org_id AND id = NEW.id;
END
